known_outcome: Council answers (leakage): yes, Group E is more hazardous than Group B and must meet new-construction requirements including sprinklers under IFC 903.2.2(3); 'newly constructed' is defined in 903.2.2 as an addition, alteration or remodel costing 100% of the building value over one year, and change of occupancy is not addressed by that definition; yes, a change to a more hazardous occupancy must conform to the IBC for that occupancy (IBC 3406.1).
review_focus: sprinkler trigger for a more hazardous occupancy
